Thompson, Moylan to Announce Bipartisan Bill to Lower Student Loans

WASHINGTON, D.C. — Today, U.S. Representatives Mike Thompson (CA-04) and James Moylan (Guam-AL) introduced the Lowering Student Loans Act, legislation to amend the Higher Education Act of 1965 and set a fixed 2 percent interest rate for all Federal Direct student loans.

Washington – On Wednesday, March 4, Rep. Mike Thompson (CA-04) and Rep. James Moylan (Guam-AL) will hold a press conference in HVC Studio A at 2:00 p.m. to announce the introduction of their bipartisan Lowering Student Loans Act, legislation to lower the cost of students loans by setting a fixed two percent interest rate for all Federal Direct student loans.
